articles.title: UN Reports Global Food Prices Reach Near 4-Year High in September
articles.summary: The United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has announced that food prices across the world climbed to their highest point in nearly four years during September 2026. The price increases cover a wide range of everyday food items that families depend on. Experts say a mix of extreme weather events, difficulties in shipping goods, and growing demand are all pushing costs higher. When food becomes more expensive, families with lower incomes struggle the most to afford enough meals. The FAO monitors food prices worldwide every month so that governments can plan better and help protect people from hunger.

lv1: What United Nations agency reported that global food prices went up? (哪個聯合國機構報告全球食品價格上漲？)
How long ago were food prices last this high — almost how many years? (食品價格上一次升至這麼高是多少年前的事？)
lv2: Why might extreme weather events cause food to become more expensive for people around the world? (為什麼極端天氣事件可能導致全球食品價格上漲？)
How does a rise in global food prices affect people in poorer countries differently from those in wealthy countries? (全球食品價格上漲對貧窮國家的人和富裕國家的人有何不同的影響？)
lv3: Some people argue that wealthy nations should pay more to help poorer countries cope when global food prices spike. Do you agree? Who should bear the responsibility? (有人認為，當全球食品價格急升時，富裕國家應該付出更多來幫助較貧窮的國家。你同意嗎？誰應該承擔這個責任？)

Climate change is closely linked to extreme weather and rising food prices. Should ordinary citizens change their eating habits to help solve this problem, or is that too much to ask of individuals? (氣候變化與極端天氣和食品價格上漲密切相關。普通市民是否應該改變飲食習慣來幫助解決這個問題，還是這對個人要求太多？)

articles.title: Tech Company AMD Pays US$8.2 Billion for AI Firm Co-Founded by Scientist Fei-Fei Li
articles.summary: American chip maker AMD has struck a deal to buy an artificial intelligence company called World Labs for about 8.2 billion US dollars. World Labs was started by Fei-Fei Li, a celebrated computer scientist famous for helping machines learn to recognise images. The takeover is among the largest AI deals of the year, highlighting just how fiercely technology companies are competing to lead the field of artificial intelligence. AMD believes that bringing World Labs' cutting-edge research in-house will help it better challenge rivals in the booming AI market. Fei-Fei Li is expected to join AMD as part of the agreement.

lv1: How much money did AMD offer to pay for World Labs? (AMD提出花多少錢收購World Labs？)
Who is the famous scientist who co-founded World Labs? (World Labs的著名聯合創辦人科學家是誰？)
lv2: Why might a big company prefer to buy an existing AI start-up rather than develop new AI technology on its own? (為什麼大公司可能更願意收購現有的人工智能初創公司，而不是自行研發新技術？)
What does this enormous deal tell us about how the technology industry views artificial intelligence today? (這宗龐大的收購交易告訴我們，今日科技行業如何看待人工智能？)
lv3: When a powerful corporation acquires a small innovative company, there are potential benefits but also risks — including the loss of independent thinking and bold ideas. On balance, do you think such takeovers are good or bad for technological progress? (當大型企業收購小型創新公司時，既有潛在好處，也有風險，包括失去獨立思考和大膽創意。整體而言，你認為這類收購對科技進步是好事還是壞事？)

Fei-Fei Li has advocated for ethical and human-centred AI. Do you think scientists who hold these values can maintain them after joining a profit-driven corporation? What challenges might they face? (李飛飛一直倡導以道德和以人為本的人工智能。你認為持有這些價值觀的科學家在加入以盈利為目標的企業後，能否堅守這些信念？他們可能面臨哪些挑戰？)

articles.title: 六成直資學校加學費　啟思中一學費近10萬元
articles.summary: 香港約六成直資學校宣布調高學費，其中啟思學校中一學費升至接近10萬元，林大輝中學亦加價約9,000元。直資學校議會表示，學費加幅已獲教育局審批，屬合理範圍。直資學校同時接受政府資助及向家長收取學費，課程自主度較高。有家長擔心加幅令普通家庭難以承擔；亦有意見認為學校需要足夠資源才能維持教學質素。教育局鼓勵各校向有需要的學生提供學費減免，以保障教育機會平等。

lv1: 這次宣布加學費的直資學校，大約佔全港直資學校的幾成？
啟思學校的中一學費大約升至多少錢？
lv2: 直資學校和官立學校在收費方面有什麼分別？為什麼直資學校可以收取學費？
學費上漲對家境較富裕和較清貧的學生，各有什麼不同影響？
lv3: 你認為政府應否為直資學校設定學費上限？這樣做對學校自主和教育公平各有什麼利弊？
如果優質學校的學費持續上漲，香港的教育制度能否真正做到機會均等？請從不同角度分析。

articles.title: 港產體感遊戲機Nex美國爆紅　銷量突破100萬部
articles.summary: 由香港人創辦的互動體感遊戲機品牌Nex，近年在美國市場取得亮眼成績，銷量已突破100萬部。品牌曾與知名韓國音樂組合BTS及卡通角色超音鼠攜手合作，主攻家庭娛樂客群。創辦人表示，志在將公司發展成「年年賺錢的百年老店」。Nex的成功說明香港初創企業有能力在國際市場站穩陣腳，為有志創業的年輕人提供了寶貴的啟示和鼓勵。

lv1: Nex遊戲機是由哪裡的人創辦的？
Nex在美國的銷售量達到了多少部？
lv2: Nex為什麼要與BTS和超音鼠等知名品牌合作？這對品牌推廣有什麼幫助？
香港的初創企業要打入國際市場，需要克服哪些困難？
lv3: 香港一向以金融業聞名，但Nex的例子顯示本地科技創意產業同樣有發展潛力。你認為香港政府和社會應如何支持更多本地科技初創企業？
創辦人希望公司成為『百年老店』，但科技行業日新月異，競爭激烈。你認為一家科技企業要維持長久成功，最重要的條件是什麼？
